predictions.articleTitle: Hertha BSC vs Arminia Bielefeld Prediction: High-Press Dominance Meets Transition Threat — Scoreline Preview
predictions.coreRecommendation: Hertha BSC to secure the outright victory in regulation time backed by superior possession dominance and home fortress form.
possibilityAssessment: Hertha BSC control settled possession and out-create Arminia's low block to claim a multi-goal victory (Confidence: High, Value: High)
Arminia Bielefeld score via direct transition through Joel Grodowski but Hertha respond to prevail 2:1 (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Bielefeld hold out defensively through first-half discipline before Hertha's bench depth breaks the deadlock after the break (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: League leaders Hertha target revenge at fortress Olympiastadion against away-fragile Bielefeld.

spf.comment: Hertha's unblemished home form and 22-point league-leading momentum clearly overmatch Bielefeld's three away defeats.

over_under.comment: Hertha's prolific 2.38 goals per game combined with Bielefeld's 2.0 away goals conceded strongly favors Over 2.5.

score.comment: A 2:1 home victory reflects Hertha's offensive superiority alongside Arminia's isolated transitional scoring threat.

goals.comment: Three goals represent the primary probabilistic convergence, with two goals offering a credible clean-sheet alternative.

bqc.comment: Hertha's strong first-half front-foot intensity supports Win-Win, while Draw-Win covers a stubborn opening 45 minutes.
